assumptions: The historical-recovery apply lane already performs the exact-SHA checkout with freshness check, preview project assertion, and ledger verification, so its success carries the same attestation the release signal names.
The gate's context match is on the status context only, so a description marking historical proof changes nothing the gate reads.
goal: Fix #5086: the historical-recovery preview apply lane posts the exact-SHA Post-merge preview rehearsal success status, so the merge queue's shared-preview hold releases when the merged-main apply is impossible because preview already holds every allowlisted version.
prohibited_actions: No change to the hard guard, the gate, the authorization/interlock/lock logic, or production logic.
No weakening of the success()-only posting condition.
stop_conditions: Stop before any production, preview, database or repository-setting action.
